name: io.jober/jober-mcp
title: Jober (자버) KakaoTalk AlimTalk
description: Send KakaoTalk AlimTalk (카카오 알림톡), SMS (문자) and email campaigns in Korea from AI agents

environmentVariables.name: JOBER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Jober personal API key (jbr_live_...). Sign up at https://jober.io/start/ai?src=mcp&client=registry, then create a key at https://jober.io/settings/integrations. Without it the server starts in guide-only mode (get_started tool).

environmentVariables.name: JOBER_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Jober API base URL. The proxy connects to <base>/mcp.
